context.guidance: Require authentication on every route that returns Personal Data, and check on each request that the authenticated Data Principal owns the record or holds a role authorised for it. Do not let an identifier supplied in the path or body decide ownership. Apply the check to every method on the route, because Rule 6(1)(b) requires access to the resources holding Personal Data to be controlled.

value.fix: Keep security.isAuthorized() on GET /api/Complaints and add a per-request authorization check on the same route for every HTTP method. Take the caller's identity only from the verified token or session, never from a path, query, or body parameter. For a Data Principal, return only complaints whose owner ID matches that identity. Allow broader access only when the authenticated user holds an explicitly authorised role, such as a grievance officer or admin, and enforce that role check server-side. Deny with 403 when neither condition is met, and log denials. Where the handler fetches a single complaint by ID, verify ownership or role on that record before returning it.
